title: Snap unveils $2,195 Specs, its first AR glasses that are "fully standalone" and have a 51-degree field of view, expected "this fall" in the US, UK, and France (Jay Peters/The Verge)
summary: Jay Peters / The Verge: Snap unveils $2,195 Specs, its first AR glasses that are “fully standalone” and have a 51-degree field of view, expected “this fall” in the US, UK, and France — The new Specs are priced at $2,195, and you can preorder them starting today.
contentText:
Jay Peters / The Verge :

Snap unveils $2,195 Specs, its first AR glasses that are “fully standalone” and have a 51-degree field of view, expected “this fall” in the US, UK, and France   —  The new Specs are priced at $2,195, and you can preorder them starting today.
